study: Dual Momentum SPY-Underperformance Antecedent Audit v1
purpose: Test whether a small frozen set of conditions known by T-1 predicts daily Dual Momentum underperformance versus SPY, while distinguishing relative misses from absolute account losses.

strategySources.configuration: 63-session lookback, top 5, daily rebalance, frozen 26-symbol universe
strategySources.execution: Use the execution overlay frozen in research/dm_regime_dependence_v1_preregistration.json.
strategySources.evidenceCap: exploratory_historical because the configuration was selected using this development period

strategySources.configuration: registered 189-session lookback, top 5, monthly rebalance, point-in-time Dow membership
strategySources.execution: Retain the canonical registered cost model.

primaryEvent.definition: strategy close-to-close return at T minus aligned SPY close-to-close return at T is strictly below zero

quadrants: strategy return < 0 and active return < 0: absolute loss plus SPY underperformance
strategy return < 0 and active return >= 0: absolute loss but SPY outperformance
strategy return >= 0 and active return < 0: profitable but opportunity-cost day
strategy return >= 0 and active return >= 0: profitable and SPY-outperforming day
dailyOutcomes.severeRelativeMiss: The bottom-decile active-return cutoff estimated only from the earliest 60% of aligned observations, then frozen and evaluated descriptively on the final 40%.
dailyOutcomes.absoluteLoss: strategy daily return strictly below zero
dailyOutcomes.jointDamagingEvent: strategy daily return below zero and active return below zero
dailyOutcomes.betaAdjustedSensitivity: Residual return equals strategy return minus rolling 252-session beta, estimated through T-1, times SPY return T. Residual-underperformance rates are descriptive only.

primaryQualifications.trueState: SPY close at T-1 above its 200-session SMA through T-1
primaryQualifications.source: identical frozen definition from the regime-dependence audit

primaryQualifications.trueState: SPY 21-session realized volatility through T-1 above the median of its preceding 252 estimates
primaryQualifications.source: identical frozen definition from the regime-dependence audit

primaryQualifications.trueState: T-1 constituent return dispersion above its preceding 63-session median
primaryQualifications.source: identical frozen definition from the regime-dependence audit

primaryQualifications.trueState: strategy equity through T-1 is at least 5% below its prior running peak
primaryQualifications.source: fixed economically interpretable threshold; not searched

primaryQualifications.trueState: strategy 21-session realized volatility through T-1 above the median of its preceding 63 estimates
primaryQualifications.source: point-in-time adaptive state; threshold history excludes the current estimate

primaryInference.testFamily: 10 tests: two strategies crossed with five qualifications; primary event only
primaryInference.estimand: P(underperformed SPY | qualification true) minus P(underperformed SPY | qualification false)
primaryInference.multipleTesting: Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all 10 primary tests
primaryInference.stableCandidateRule: q <= 0.10, 95% block-bootstrap risk-difference CI excludes zero, both qualification states have at least 63 observations, at least 30 underperformance events occur, at least three calendar years contribute, and at least 80% of usable leave-one-year-out estimates share the full-sample direction

interpretationGuards: Qualification values must be available no later than T-1; same-day losses, fills, contributions, and slippage cannot be predictive qualifications.
A high P(qualification | bad day) is never treated as predictive without comparison to the qualification's unconditional base rate.
Secondary outcomes and beta-adjusted sensitivity are descriptive and cannot rescue a failed primary test.
Optimized DM remains capped at exploratory historical evidence regardless of p-values.
No condition may suppress, resize, create, modify, or cancel a live order.
No threshold or qualification may be added after results are observed.

prospectiveExtension.separation: prospective observations remain separate from all historical statistics
